Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: native-scale pixel-art speech mouth atlas for a Daggerfall Unity NPC portrait
Input image: Image 1 is the sole exact reference grid; preserve this woman's identity, source palette, face framing, lower-face scale, hair, and native pixel-cluster style.
Primary request: Return one clean 3×3 atlas of complete lower portrait halves, nine equal cells in row-major order A B C / D E F / G H X. Each cell represents the full 64×29 lower half at the same scale and framing as the supplied grid; no labels, borders, gutters, zooming, or rescaling.
Expression: Keep a quiet, clearly sad expression. Use gently downturned, understated mouth corners and the source's muted terracotta lip hue. Preserve the source nose, cheeks, chin, neck, hair, and background. Vary mouth pose only; do not add tears or other features.
Rhubarb mouth poses, in this exact order:
A: closed, pressured lips for P/B/M.
B: narrow opening with teeth nearly together for consonants/EE.
C: medium unrounded opening for EH/AE.
D: wide AA opening.
E: slightly rounded AO/ER opening, no wider than C.
F: puckered UW/OW/W lips.
G: upper teeth touching the lower lip for F/V.
H: tongue raised behind the upper teeth for L, with an opening between C and D.
X: relaxed closed idle.
Anatomy and color: Keep the original lip scale and mouth placement. Teeth only where the pose calls for them; use subdued neutral gray-ivory teeth, visibly distinct from skin but not shiny white. Use a modest dark oral cavity where open poses require it. Closed A and X retain the sad expression without exaggeration.
Avoid: bright white teeth, skin-colored teeth, lipstick-red saturation, thick black outlines, extreme downturned corners, large mouth enlargement, changed face shape, stray pixels, text, labels, or watermark.
